ModMetaData.name: SloppyMods Agricultural Statistics
ModMetaData.author: SloppyMod
ModMetaData.description:
Build 0.9.3
Adds a Farming tab that answers one question: will my farms feed my colony?
Every growing zone, hydroponics basin and plant pot is listed with what it grows, its size, soil fertility and how far along the crop is, plus how much nutrition it produces per day and how many people that feeds eaten raw, cooked into simple meals, or as nutrient paste.
- Compare your harvest with what your colonists, prisoners and slaves actually eat (their real hunger rates, so genes, traits and children count). - See it right now, or averaged over the whole year using your map's growing season, to plan for winter. - Animal feed crops such as haygrass are counted against your animals' needs, not your colonists'. - Warnings for zones too cold to grow, short of light, with sowing turned off, or on soil too poor for the crop. - Click a row to jump to the zone.
Works with modded crops, meals, races and growers: everything is read from the game's own data, and planted crops report their real growth rate, so fertilizer, growth boosters and other mods that speed up or slow down growth are counted. No Harmony, safe to add or remove mid-save.
